name: One-Page Map
author: ernes
description: Displays the entire Slay the Spire 2 act map on one screen instead of scrolling vertically, with room-type outlines, optional horizontal layout compression with curved paths, and an optional toggle to fade unreachable rooms. Keeps the game's own icons, legend, map drawings, quest markers, visited-room tooltips, and controls (M to toggle map, F to switch between one-page and scrolling views). Does not change cards, routes, travel rules, combat, rewards, saves, or any other gameplay. Targets Slay the Spire 2 v0.113.1.
